transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this review. As you know, we're here to discuss the proposed conversion of Lab 3 into a robotics laboratory for the next academic year. The draft request proposes 12 student workstations and makes use of the existing room infrastructure. Before I can issue my decision, I need to walk through the key requirements with each of you. The robotics equipment vendor has specified that we need power, network connectivity, and a documented funding source in place before they'll deliver the equipment. So I'd like to go around the room and hear from each of you on your respective areas. Let's start with facilities — can you walk me through the power situation in Lab 3 and whether the existing infrastructure will support the conversion?
